notes: A 200 m tunnel (6 × 6 m) closed at both ends: no intake, no exhaust. A Ø1220 mm duct runs from 10 m to 190 m with a fan held at 50 m³/s. The air goes out through the duct and back along the tunnel. Mass conservation: the same mass flow in the duct inlet, the duct outlet and the tunnel between the duct ends; none beyond the duct ends.

expected.basis: closed system, no leakage: continuity (mass in = mass out at every node)
